reviews.review: merenary is love. mercenary is life.
I LOVE RISK OF RAIN RAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH

It's the third time that I'm getting scammed from a video game, that makes it seem like in its trailer, that you can play with people all over the world, matchmaking, "push a button and you're set", etc. I hate when they show in the trailer all of this fun, pew pew all over the place (cause 4 players) and so on, then you purchase the game, you try to learn the ropes of the game, and then you find out that in Risk of Rain Returns, there are ZERO lobbies, ZERO, not even 1, not even an exageration (and I've refreshed the list for like 4-5 minutes). Then I go on the internet to google "Risk of Rain Returns why are there no lobbies?" and I find a reddit post, with people saying in the comments that this game is not really a game that you wanna play with others, most of the people play solo. Then there was one guy saying "if the lobby host is a baby and he exits because he dies, the session is over" (yes this is true, it's annoying, but idc, I buy this game because I ONLY play online games), then there's one passive aggressive guy saying "I don't want a guy with whatever fast traveling item, to zoom in and steal every loot for himself" and what not. And then there's another guy saying that in order to find people to play with, you gotta join their discord and LOOK for people. Nah, I'm gewd. We all know how it usually ends with such games that have Discord as a method to team up with others: Dark and Darker, Once Human, Marvel Rivals, you name it. It usually ends up in a toxic scenario, where someone is good and someone is bad, the blame game of voice chat, then there's a fight, slurrs, death threats, you name it. I want a fast button, push it and done, whether it's "join lobby", or "matchmaking" or whatever the hell it is. Deep Rock Galactic, Warframe, you name it, that simple. Maybe even "drop-in" feature (drop-in means that a player can be replaced by another player if the player A disconnects/ exits and player B is in queue).

I can't refund the game anymore because I have 8 hours of playtime, ex dee deeeee. Isn't that fun? to have the need to learn the ropes of the game and be hyped that you're gonna play with others, but you CAN'T. If only games would give you what they show you in their trailers... and if only we would develop features and functions/ systems that 2023 (like the release date of the game) has as an expectancy of people. But nah, we gotta show them, in our trailer, a FUN game, which is not even close to what you see in it. Erase like half or even 75% of the trailer, containing 4 players on the screen, and you have the real game, Risk of Rain Returns (which by the way, you finish the game in like half an hour - 1 hour, reading and learning process not included). Happy Singleplayer time. Fifteen f****** euros for a singleplayer game that you finish in half hour - 1 hour.
